set(SCDOC_DIR ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/SCDoc)

# lex.scdoc.cpp and SCDoc.tab.{cpp,hpp} are generated by Flex and Bison and committed, so normal users do not need
# either. Flex (2.6 or newer) and Bison (3.8 or newer) are only needed, and only run, when SCDoc.l or SCDoc.y differs
# from the version the committed files were generated from. That is tracked by a hash per input, as timestamps are
# unreliable in git. macOS ships an outdated Bison, use Homebrew's, e.g. -DBISON_EXECUTABLE=$(brew --prefix bison)/bin/bison.
# This file is included by lang, the IDE and sc_check_docs; later includes find the hashes match and do nothing.

# Sets out_var to the hash of input if it differs from the one in input.sha256, else to the empty string.
# Line endings are removed before hashing, as git may check out CRLF on Windows.
function(scdoc_changed_hash input out_var)
    set_property(DIRECTORY APPEND PROPERTY CMAKE_CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ${input})
    file(READ ${input} contents)
    string(REPLACE "\r" "" contents "${contents}")
    string(SHA256 hash "${contents}")
    file(STRINGS ${input}.sha256 old_hash LIMIT_COUNT 1)
    string(STRIP "${old_hash}" old_hash)
    if(hash STREQUAL old_hash)
        set(${out_var} "" PARENT_SCOPE)
    else()
        set(${out_var} ${hash} PARENT_SCOPE)
    endif()
endfunction()

# Run from the source root so the #line directives hold repo relative paths.
scdoc_changed_hash(${SCDOC_DIR}/SCDoc.l SCDOC_L_HASH)
if(SCDOC_L_HASH)
    find_package(FLEX 2.6 REQUIRED)
    message(STATUS "SCDoc.l changed, regenerating the lexer with Flex ${FLEX_VERSION}")
    execute_process(
        COMMAND ${FLEX_EXECUTABLE} -P scdoc -o SCDoc/lex.scdoc.cpp SCDoc/SCDoc.l
        WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}
        RESULT_VARIABLE SCDOC_FLEX_RESULT
    )
    if(NOT SCDOC_FLEX_RESULT EQUAL 0)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Flex failed on SCDoc.l")
    endif()
    file(WRITE ${SCDOC_DIR}/SCDoc.l.sha256 "${SCDOC_L_HASH}\n")
endif()

scdoc_changed_hash(${SCDOC_DIR}/SCDoc.y SCDOC_Y_HASH)
if(SCDOC_Y_HASH)
    find_package(BISON 3.8 REQUIRED)
    message(STATUS "SCDoc.y changed, regenerating the parser with Bison ${BISON_VERSION}")
    execute_process(
        COMMAND ${BISON_EXECUTABLE}
            -Wall
            -Werror
            -p scdoc
            --defines=SCDoc/SCDoc.tab.hpp
            -o SCDoc/SCDoc.tab.cpp
            SCDoc/SCDoc.y
        WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}
        RESULT_VARIABLE SCDOC_BISON_RESULT
    )
    if(NOT SCDOC_BISON_RESULT EQUAL 0)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Bison failed on SCDoc.y")
    endif()
    file(WRITE ${SCDOC_DIR}/SCDoc.y.sha256 "${SCDOC_Y_HASH}\n")
endif()

set(SCDOC_SRCS
    ${SCDOC_DIR}/SCDoc.cpp
    ${SCDOC_DIR}/SCDoc.h
    ${SCDOC_DIR}/SCDoc.tab.cpp
    ${SCDOC_DIR}/lex.scdoc.cpp
    ${SCDOC_DIR}/SCDocPrim.cpp
)

if(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "Clang")
    set_source_files_properties(
        ${SCDOC_DIR}/lex.scdoc.cpp
        PROPERTIES COMPILE_FLAGS "-Wno-null-conversion"
    )
endif()

include_directories(
    ${SCDOC_DIR}
)
